title: Echinopsis peruviana

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Echinopsis peruviana (also known as Trichocereus peruvianus or Peruvian torch cactus) is a fast-growing columnar cactus with long spines native to the western slope of the Andes in Peru. It contains psychedelic alkaloids such as mescaline.

See also

* Echinopsis pachanoi (San pedro)
* Echinopsis lageniformis (Bolivian torch)
* Mescaline
